Cross-source agreement and suspected reuse

Points that match another paper's point within the copy tolerance (same chemistry, ratio ±0.005, concentration ±0.001, T ±0.05 K, conductivity ±0.5%). When two papers share at least three such points (suspected_reuse_linked) they are treated as one source group, so they never sit on both sides of a source split. Isolated agreements are listed but not linked.

Task eligibility and interpretation labels

Labels: supported_comparison intended shift present with documented overlap of nuisance dimensions; combined_shift chemistry, source or conditions change together; insufficient_support too few groups or no credible overlap. These describe evaluation support, not causal identification.
